title: Upgrading
description: Allows you to optionally upgrade your tools in smithing tables
body:
[![Kinetic Hosting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1af71189dede4258766a75b4957acefce1910966.webp)](https://billing.kinetichosting.com/aff.php?aff=1406)

Adds optional upgrading to all tiered tools and armor

there's no specific order to what needs to be upgraded first, meaning you can jump to diamond from copper

downgrading is also possible, why would you do this? I don't know

This was made with the intention of allowing players to port enchantments and armor trims from their old stuff to their newer ones
